name: Proud People
overview: Scripture clearly reveals that pride is detestable to the Lord and leads to serious consequences. The proud are rebuked and cursed because they stray from God's commandments, and their arrogance brings shame and destruction. In contrast, humility is associated with wisdom and honor, as God upholds those who are lowly in spirit. Thus, pride not only invites God's judgment but also results in personal downfall, underscoring the necessity of fearing the Lord and rejecting pride.
